user_clarification: Use existing engineer verification and rejection reasons for the six known projects; no blanket repeat verification requested.
evaluation_policy: Reuse the engineer decision for the same atomic claim, object, source version and context; do not transfer it solely by matching keywords or IDs.
Keep original claim, engineer decision, rejection reason, engineer clarification and later audit inference separate.
Coordinator semantic matching is recorded as coordinator work, not as a new engineer decision.
Rejected does not imply false; duplicates, profile and low significance remain separate.
Only novel, materially changed or unresolved claims enter the exception review queue.
Frozen evaluator holds and disputed cases remain unscored; no retrospective change to the running trial.
Historical labels do not measure present engineer review time. Mark workload unknown; do not claim its acceptance gate passed.
No matching/evaluator material is passed to the executing audit models; no candidate tuning from these sealed outputs during this series.
